description: Czech & EU due-diligence and KYC/AML MCP servers — company facts, insolvency (ISIR), EU + OFAC sanctions screening, VAT-payer reliability, phoenix & nominee-director detection, quantified risk score and statutory-chain (UBO) ownership analysis. A unified due-diligence aggregator across 16 foreign business registries; Lithuania JAR provides identity, registration date and legal-status labels without address or officer enrichment.
